g.text: DURABLE FLOOR DECISION / CONTEXT FENCE / FINAL RELEASE

text.tspan: Commit and fence races / lost replies / stale workers / retained obligations
Unique durable decision / retained intent / original claim and budget
Fence first retains the locked intent
Late reply cannot relabel a decision
Old FD / DMA / queued digest paths
Only original commit unlocks its slot
No hardware readiness from a receipt
